title: Reset the Wahoo Elemnt Roam because Xdrip connection is not working
symptom: The user tried to set up a Wahoo Elemnt to display glucose data while cycling, following instructions for the Wahoo Elemnt Bolt, but it is not working. They only see a big 'Scanning' on every page of the Wahoo and cannot display data. They also cannot figure out how to remove the 'Scanning' entry from the Wahoo.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One commenter suggests that the issue may be due to a strange file on the Wahoo when connected as a USB device, but this is not confirmed. Another commenter states that it is not possible to use an Android Wear device as a collector for Libre2 or newer sensors, but this is not directly related to the Wahoo issue.
fix: One commenter suggests connecting the Wahoo to a computer as a USB device and deleting a strange file (name not remembered) to prevent the empty data field from reappearing. However, this is not confirmed as a fix. The original user later said the problem was solved by reorganizing data on the Wahoo, but then later said it is not working and the scanning field persists.
evidence_quote: You should connect the wahoo to a computer as a USB device. There is one strange file, don't remember the name but you will recognise it. Just delete that one. Otherwise, the empty data field will pop up time and again.
